## About
Fleet Masters Truck and Trailer Repair is a full-service truck and trailer shop in Medley. We handle roadside assistance, in-shop repairs, tire repair, and truck and trailer repairs, with a focus on diesel vehicles.
Our mechanics work on trucks and trailers of different makes and models, and we keep branded spare parts in the shop so you are not stuck waiting. Along with Medley, we list locations in Tampa and Jacksonville and a nationwide network.
Drivers rate us 4.7 from 341 Google reviews. Reviewers have written about our techs reaching them on the side of the road in places like Ocala, Florida and Clarksville, Arkansas.

## Services
- Emergency roadside assistance: Around-the-clock roadside help, so you are a phone call away from getting back on the road.
- Towing: Towing for light, medium and heavy duty vehicles.
- Truck and trailer repair: In-shop repair and maintenance for heavy vehicles, with a focus on diesel trucks and spare parts kept on hand.

## FAQ
Q: Can I call in the middle of the night?
A: Yes. We are available 24/7.

Q: How do I book service?
A: Give us a call. We can answer your questions and get you booked right away.

Q: Can I get a quote first?
A: Yes. Get in touch with us for a free quotation.
